name: vivarium-ai-tools
description: Marketplace for the IHME Simulation Science Team ai-tools plugins: simsci (generic developer workflows for any IHME team), simsci-internal (SimSci/vivarium-specific workflows), and simsci-research (SimSci research team workflows).

plugins.name: simsci
plugins.description: Generic AI developer workflows for any IHME team, any repo: review-to-PR prep (a multi-agent code review that carries the fixes through to a draft PR), git rescue, commit splitting, type hinting, regression debugging, change propagation, workflow assessment, and a guided TDD loop.

plugins.name: simsci-internal
plugins.description: For the IHME Simulation Science team only: vivarium model development and SimSci conventions (Jira, hub, Jenkins, Slack) layered on simsci; its conventions skills take over simsci's branch, ticket, and PR seams. Depends on simsci and also installs the slack plugin. Other teams: install simsci alone.

plugins.name: simsci-research
plugins.description: For the IHME Simulation Science research team: a reviewer-first summary of a session's prompts, human review, and unverified content for a PR's AI-use section. Lives in the vivarium-research-tools repo and depends on simsci.
